messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick sync / Nimbus wants a coordinated marketplace listing + joint webinar next Tue. Need blog post, benchmark blurb, webinar landing, and lead routing. Who owns what?
Eli (Demand Gen): Ill do landing + HubSpot form + UTMs. Need final speaker list by Fri EOD.
Samir (Partnerships): I'll confirm speakers and request a partner quote. Also confirm their social window.
Jordan (Product Marketing): I'll draft benchmark narrative. Propose we highlight p95 latency and cost-per-1k for an embeddings batch, plus a small quality check.
Leah (Solutions): I'll produce a 30s snippet + 90s walkthrough showing marketplace provisioning -> private deploy.
Priya (Marketing): UTM scheme: partner=nimbus, campaign=marketplace_co_launch, channel=webinar.
Eli (Demand Gen): UTM example: utm_source=nimbus&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=marketplace_co_launch&utm_content=register
HubSpot form id: 5f2a-landing-nimbus
hubspot-bot: Workflow created: "nimbus_inbound_v1" (wf_9951). Trigger: form_submission -> evaluate_arr -> assign_owner.
Samir (Partnerships): Routing ask: ARR>=50k -> Nimbus AE; otherwise -> our demo queue. HubSpot can handle with hidden field.
Leah (Solutions): Demo queue tags: demo.type=integration; demo.source=marketplace; priority=standard. I'll add to the sheet.
Jordan (Product Marketing): Eng, can you share p95 (us-west2, 512 tokens), cost/1k, and 24h error rates by tonight?
Priya (Marketing): Launch checklist: 1) Blog + partner quote (Jordan/Samir) 2) Landing + UTMs + form (Eli) 3) Demo clips + script (Leah) 4) Benchmark data (Eng->Jordan) 5) HubSpot workflows (Eli/hubspot-bot) 6) Legal approvals (Priya/Samir).
Eli (Demand Gen): Landing skeleton up: https://go.redwood/mktg/nimbus-co-launch
Priya (Marketing): Everyone drop a 1-line status by EOD; I'll compile the brief and ping Nimbus.
Leah (Solutions): status: demo bullets in drive, recording slot set.
Samir (Partnerships): status: speakers mostly confirmed, legal looped.
Eli (Demand Gen): status: landing + UTMs ready, form staged.
Jordan (Product Marketing): status: outline ready, waiting on p95/cost.
Priya (Marketing): Thanks all :raised_hands: will share final brief at 8pm.
